technical.summary: Bullish trend structure with strong moving average alignment, but overbought RSI(14), negative MACD crossover, and lack of triggered strategies limit entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: CB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 56 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Senior Republican (McCaul) selling large positions ($100k+) contradicts fear-zone opportunity signal; mixed congressional activity with no composite signal; insufficient news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (241.12) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 56 days adds event risk; financials sector particularly vulnerable to credit stress and economic contraction.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with ADX trending and Supertrend bullish suggests intact uptrend structure despite overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, senior congressional selling, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (241.12), and no triggered strategies create a toxic risk/reward environment that overwhelms technical bullishness.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure remains bullish with price above major moving averages and ADX trending, but this is insufficient to justify entry given macro crisis conditions and fundamental weakness.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (241.12) combined with inverted yield curve and senior congressional selling creates severe systemic risk; earnings in 56 days adds event uncertainty in a fragile market.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding CB position with 35 other Financials positions (10.4% sector concentration); adding to this concentration during macro crisis and yield curve inversion is imprudent.
